name: Apogee Lounge
author: kolache
description: The observation lounge of a 1970s space liner: cream moulded fibreglass and tangerine upholstery by ship-day, amber floor strips in the night cycle, a gas giant through the window. Messages are raised panels with nameplates, avatars sit in portholes.

credits.what: Cabin backdrops, storm viewport, porthole key art, ice debris
Porthole rings, mouldings, nameplates, cove light
